title: Extreme Flavor
subtitle: Do you dare with the
instructions: Step 1. Prepare your camera to record the challenge from start to finish.
Step 2. Open the bag of Taqueritos Extreme and place them on a plate.
Step 3. Start the stopwatch and eat all Taqueritos without drinking water.
Step 4. Hold the spiciness for 2 minutes after finishing.
Step 5. Upload your video to social media with #TaqueritosExtremeChallenge.
